themes.quote: MetLife Investment Management continues to expand its assets under management and client base
We are focused on growing our retirement and income solutions business, including annuities and pension risk transfer
Group Benefits segment is pursuing growth through new customer wins and expanded relationships
We continue to invest in Asia, Latin America and EMEA segments to capture growth in developing economies
We are enhancing our digital capabilities and distribution channels to reach customers more effectively
Fixed Immediate Annuities segment continues to grow, with strong sales momentum driving increased premiums and policy count
Annuities and Risk Solutions experiencing elevated demand for guaranteed minimum death benefit and annuitization benefit riders
Group Policies segment maintaining stable policy holder account balances with strategic focus on crediting rate management
Asia segment demonstrating growth across whole life, term life endowments and accident and health insurance product lines
growth in fixed annuities with strong sales momentum
Group Benefits segment revenues increased driven by premium growth across our businesses
Retirement and Income Solutions segment generated strong results with continued demand for fixed immediate annuities
Asia segment revenues grew reflecting strong performance in our protection and life insurance businesses
MetLife Investment Management segment benefited from higher fee revenue on increased assets under management
